verifications.claim: U.S. Senator Rand Paul was attacked by his neighbor Rene Boucher in November 2017.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Sen. Rand Paul was tackled by his neighbor, Rene Boucher, in Kentucky last November." (R1); "charged with assaulting Paul" (R2); "assaulted by his next door neighbor... Rene Boucher" (R3); "a neighbor tackled... Rene Boucher" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the attack by Rene Boucher on Rand Paul in November 2017.

verifications.claim: The attack occurred while Rand Paul was doing yard work at his Kentucky home.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "saw the Republican senator outside" (R1); "tackled from behind while he was mowing the yard at his home in Bowling Green, Ky." (R2); "doing yardwork at his home in Bowling Green" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state Paul was doing yard work (mowing, outside) at his Kentucky home.

verifications.claim: The attack resulted in six broken ribs for Rand Paul.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "breaking six of his ribs" (R1); "Paul suffered six broken ribs" (R4); "six of his ribs broken by a neighbour in 2017" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: The attack resulted in lung injuries for Rand Paul.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "resulting in broken ribs and bouts of pneumonia" (R1); "bruised lungs and several broken ribs" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly mentions bruised lungs; R1 implies lung issues via pneumonia.

verifications.claim: Rene Boucher pleaded guilty to assaulting a member of Congress.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "pleaded guilty to assaulting a member of Congress" (R1); "pleaded guilty in March 2018" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Exactly matches the charge and plea.
